name: agent-teams
description: Jase's agent teams, one Claude Code plugin per team.

plugins.name: dev-team
plugins.description: The shared core dev team: eleven roles, fourteen skills and one fifteen-stage milestone loop that build, gate, review in parallel, approve, audit and record any app, reading the app's own AGENTS.md (or CLAUDE.md where the app has not switched yet) for its specifics. Merging stays with the owner unless an app opts in to auto-merge.

plugins.name: design-team
plugins.description: The shared design team: a designer who extends the app's design system and writes the hand-off the dev team builds from, and a read-only design-auditor who checks the build against it. Five design skills on the owner's account are referenced, not copied.

plugins.name: toolkit
plugins.description: General-purpose skills for any team or app: watch a video in detail, find and install skills, browser automation, decide, which weighs a choice the way the project's owner does, and orchestrator, which runs every task as its own worker.

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: The Forge, the one build board every project keeps: the /forge skill plus the master renderer, contract, tool and build spec. The board moves only for asks, decisions and milestones.

plugins.name: crew-progress
plugins.description: A mod: Claude's subagents and Codex's tasks side by side in role costumes, with Codex's ChatGPT plan limits, and a status file at ~/.claude/state/crew-progress/status.md for live progress (a fork of savvy-progress, MIT).

plugins.name: auto-handoff
plugins.description: A mod: when a reply ends past 800k tokens of context (upstream's 80% of the window, on a 1M window), a Haiku-written brief, /clear, and a fresh session that reads it and the project's memory file and status board (a fork of alexknowshtml/claude-auto-handoff 8d762ce, MIT).

plugins.name: cache-tax
plugins.description: A mod that keeps the prompt cache warm during breaks and asks before a cold send (karanb192/cache-tax c4f8cf2, MIT, unchanged).

plugins.name: filetree
plugins.description: A mod: a file tree pane beside the chat that shows what Claude reads and writes (data-goblin/claude-code-filetree 3ce5b1c, MIT, unchanged).
